note: P-C-2016-52815-2e6f0093, 18 Letter sheets (612x792): one zero-text summary sheet carrying the official summary page as a raster, the letter to Mr. Alpha Chiang and the paper itself printed 'Page 1 of 17' through 'Page 17 of 17'. Six numbered figures, all captioned in the text layer, all captions printed BELOW the art in the 'Figure N:' colon form. The layout pass measures nine regions and no more: the six figures - Figure 6 split into two measured pieces - plus the summary raster and the pseudocode box. The two result tables, Table 1 on PDF page 14 and Table 2 on PDF page 15, print no rules whatsoever - their pages carry a single page-header rule - so the pass measures no region for them and they cannot be recorded as rows; they are read here from the text layer only: Table 1 'Schools Investment Strategy with Max Investment Constraints' is cited by number ('Table 1 shows the result from Bayesian Time-Series Model with constraints on the maximum disbursement to a particular school'), Table 2 'Schools Investment Strategy without Constraints' only as 'Another table 2'. What the census turns on: every figure is a second-hand R or Excel graphic pasted as a raster image, the pointer is always parenthetical or 'Figure N shows', and the figure pages lag the pointer by one or two pages - Figures 3, 4 and 5 are all pointed at from page 9 but drawn on pages 10 and 11. Two regions are not exhibits: the summary sheet pasted as a page image on page 1, and the uncaptioned pseudocode box on page 12.
rules: 图注一律编号加冒号、且只有这一种写法:六个图从 "Figure 1:" 排到 "Figure 6:",两张结果表从 "Table 1:" 排到 "Table 2:",没有一个编号用句点、没有一个用 "Fig.";唯一被画出来的无注展品是第 12 页那个算法框,它只在框内印了 "Algorithm 1" 四个字,没有 "Algorithm 1:" 式的图注 [caption.numbering]

图注全部压在图形下沿、居中、与正文同字号,而且图注会插进正文句子中间:第 5 页顶端的 "Figure 1: Initial Missingness Structure of Data" 只是七词的图注,紧跟其后的 "either to public or private schools..." 属于上一页被打断的那句话;第 12 页的 "Figure 6: 2D Example of Optimizing Funding Distribution" 下面同样接着上一页断开的句子 [caption.position]

正文指图走括号插入式与"Figure N shows"两路,没有第三种:Figure 1 用 "Figure 1 shows the initial missingness structure" 再接 "In Figure 1, the x axis represents cases",Figure 2 用 "See in Figure 2 a scatterplot",Figure 3、Figure 4、Figure 5 各用一次光秃的 "(Figure N)",Figure 6 用 "(see Figure 6)" [mention.style]
指认页普遍早于展品页:Figure 3、Figure 4、Figure 5 在同一段里连续被指认,指认页是第 9 页,而图分别画在第 10、10、11 页,领先量是 1、1、2 页;Figure 1 指认在第 4 页、画在第 5 页,Figure 6 指认在第 11 页、画在第 12 页;只有 Figure 2 的指认与图同页且落在图注之后 [mention.first_page]
色彩图例只在需要连续色标时出现:唯一带色条的是第 5 页那张缺失结构热图,色条 0-20、刻度间隔 5,并自带粗体标题 "Dark represents missing data";其余五张回归诊断图既没有图例框、没有网格线、也没有在任何一个数据点上印数值 [geometry.legend]

两图一号:Figure 6 是两张各自带坐标轴、各自带 "Goodness" 与 "Effective Tuition (Thousands of Dollars)" 标题的独立子图并排,一张图注同时管住两半,正文也用 "Both graphs above" 与"the school on the left (School A)"／"the school on the right (School B)" 分读左右 [geometry.panel_count]
